decisions.comment: The skipped bracket-hole patch is unfinished work, and the note never states a planned return, so followUps stays empty.
The stain was fetched for this deck staining job, so it counts as used under the supply-house rule; the concern does not hold.
The picked-up thermostat is the one installed, so it is a material; the old unit being shot is the job's own reason, not a separate found issue.
